decay.title: Decay settings
decay.description: Configure how quickly activity fades and how sessions end.

data_description.default_half_life: How fast activity fades when the source is inactive. 30 s = fast decay, 60 s = normal, 180 s = slow. Lower values end sessions sooner after the last event.
data_description.end_threshold: Score (0–100) below which the session moves to the ending state. The default of 5 means the session ends when almost no evidence of activity remains.
data_description.end_grace: Seconds the session stays in the ending state before it closes completely. A brief window to catch one final event.
data_description.restore_session: When enabled, an active or decaying session is restored across Home Assistant restarts.
data_description.add_stages: Optionally define named time ranges (e.g. Short, Medium, Long) with different decay rates per stage.

init.title: Options

data_description.default_half_life: How fast activity fades when the source is inactive. 30 s = fast, 60 s = normal, 180 s = slow.
data_description.end_threshold: Score (0–100) below which the session enters the ending state. Lower values keep sessions alive longer after the last event.
data_description.end_grace: Seconds the session stays in the ending state before closing completely.
data_description.restore_session: Reopen an active session after Home Assistant restarts.
data_description.add_stages: Add one or more duration stages to the current list.
data_description.clear_all_stages: Remove all currently configured duration stages. This takes effect when you save.

stage.title: Add duration stage
stage.description: Define one stage. Check "Done" to return without adding.

data.name: Stage name
data.done_adding_stages: Done — return without adding this stage

data_description.id: Short identifier used in automations, e.g. 'short' or 'medium'.
data_description.name: Label shown in the stage sensor state, e.g. 'Short' or 'Medium'.
data_description.min_duration: Session must have been open at least this many seconds to enter this stage.
data_description.max_duration: Leave empty for no upper limit. The last stage is usually unbounded.
data_description.half_life: Leave empty to inherit the default half-life. Longer half-life = slower decay in this stage.
data_description.add_another: Check to add another stage immediately after saving this one.
data_description.done_adding_stages: Check this instead of filling in a stage to return to options without adding.
